title: Org RBAC binding (ADR-017 / AE-039a)
description: Disk-backed org/team/project role binding. Separate from agent config/roles/*.json. Empty or missing store denies org-scoped ops (fail closed). Grants are never taken from caller input.

tenant_id.description: Pilot tenant_id (human-written in project config; not inferred).

principal.description: Principal this binding authorizes (e.g. user:<id>, role:<id>). Exact match only.

actions.description: Actions this principal may perform on the resource under the tenant.

resource.description: Org-scoped resource this binding covers (exactly one of org/team/project).
